approach: Add a pure `code_health` module in athena-core measuring each tracked .rs file under crates/ and xtask/ (production lines cut at #[cfg(test)] mod, longest function via syn, 7-day landings and failure citations from records, suite time from latest passing test CheckRun). Thresholds are constants (2000 lines, 200-line fn, 1500 lines with 5 weekly landings). StatusView gets a code_health field; display::status renders an aligned table. An idempotent Athena::after_landing hook queues one structural-pass request per breaching file (marker-line dedupe) and a high-priority self-contained design-review request every 10 landings (baseline from the latest design-review-marked request, else current landed count). It is called from the end of land_pr (Landed) and from note_finished; failures only warn.

decisions.choice: Measure function length with syn (full, proc-macro2 span-locations); record the call in docs/decisions.md.
decisions.reason: buy-first; exact spans, handles nested fns and impl methods.

rejected.why: Breaks on braces in strings, comments, raw strings.
Pass/fail only; no per-file numbers for the table or queue.

decisions.choice: Derive review baseline from records: latest design-review-marked request, else current landed count.
decisions.reason: Survives state loss; history alone never fires a review.

rejected.why: Fires at once on history, forbidden by criterion 4.

decisions.choice: Hook in both land_pr (Landed) and note_finished, one idempotent function.
decisions.reason: Criterion 6 needs both paths; marker dedupe makes double calls harmless.

decisions.choice: Hook errors become ui warnings, never failures.

rejected.why: Would report a done landing as failed.

decisions.choice: Table header built from the same width constants as rows.
decisions.reason: Aligns columns to labels; testable by offset.

decisions.choice: Criterion 8 is shown by running the three gates, with a control: a deliberately-failing gate state is what the gates catch (unformatted code, a clippy warning, a failing test).
decisions.reason: Gates are the only way to show the whole change is clean; they fail on any regression.

files.purpose: Measurement, thresholds, structural-pass and design-review queueing, after_landing hook, unit tests.
Add code_health field to StatusView, filled in Athena::status.
Call after_landing at end of land_pr when Landed; warn only.
Call hook from note_finished for a landed job.
Only if needed to pass the finished job to the hook.
Lock the added dependencies and features.
Render aligned code-health table with thresholds and suite time; render test.
Integration tests for land_pr and finished-job hooks.

steps: Add syn (full) and proc-macro2 (span-locations) to athena-core Cargo.toml (use workspace = true if listed); update Cargo.lock via cargo build.
Write code_health.rs constants, FileHealth, production-line count and syn longest-fn.
Add record-derived inputs: landings in window with changed files, failure/rejection citations, suite time.
Add queue_structural_passes with marker dedupe, committed via Committer::commit_records.
Add queue_design_review_if_due with record-derived baseline and self-contained high-priority text.
Add Athena::after_landing; call from land_pr (Landed) and note_finished; warn on error.
Add StatusView field and render aligned table in display.rs from shared width constants.
Write unit tests, display test, and code_health_hooks.rs integration tests (disk minimum 0).
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Records may not list changed files per job.
risks.mitigation: Use git diff-tree on the candidate commit; count nothing if absent, with a test.

risks.risk: Hook's records commit races with landing's own writes.
risks.mitigation: Run after merge and records are done, via Committer; errors are warnings.

risks.risk: syn parsing slows status or fails on a file.
risks.mitigation: Parse tracked .rs files once; list unparseable files as unmeasured.

risks.risk: New StatusView field breaks constructions or snapshots.
risks.mitigation: Single construction site in status.rs; run full suite.
Set disk minimum to 0 in new tests as 3947eb3 does.

demonstrations.method: Unit test builds a temp tree with a fixture .rs file (production code, a #[cfg(test)] mod, one long fn) and fixture records (landed jobs inside/outside 7 days, a rejected and a failed job citing it); calls measure and asserts exact numbers.
demonstrations.observes: Production lines exclude the test module; longest fn equals fixture length; weekly landings count only in-window jobs; citations count failed and rejected jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the cfg(test) cutoff the line count is too high; without the 7-day filter the old landing is counted.

demonstrations.method: Table-driven test: 2001-line file, 201-line fn, 1501 lines with 5 landings, 1501 lines with 4 landings, small file, each through breaches.
demonstrations.observes: First three reported with reason; the 4-landing and small files not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A removed threshold leaves its case unreported; an over-eager rule flags the clean file.

demonstrations.method: Temp git repo with records: queue_structural_passes after a breach; call again; call with an open request carrying the marker.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one athena.request/1 citing path, lines, longest fn, weekly landings; zero on second call and when open request exists.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without dedupe the second call adds a request and the count assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Synthetic landed-job records: review request then 9 landings, then a 10th; separate case with no earlier review and 25 landed jobs.
demonstrations.observes: Nothing at 9; one request at 10th with priority High; nothing on existing history without a prior review.
demonstrations.fails_without: Off-by-one queues at 9 or not at 10; from-zero baseline fires at once.

demonstrations.method: Test reads the queued review text and asserts each required phrase.
demonstrations.observes: Text names code-health table, most changed and most broken files since last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops, and asks for a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Text missing any item fails the per-phrase assert.

demonstrations.method: Integration tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/code_health_hooks.rs, disk minimum set to 0 as in 3947eb3: drive Athena::land_pr on a repo with an over-threshold file and assert a structural-pass request exists; same for the finished-job hook; control without the hook call shows none.
demonstrations.observes: After land_pr lands, one structural-pass request is queued; after a landed finished job, the check ran.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the hook call from land_pr or note_finished queues no request and the assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Render display::status with a StatusView holding code-health rows and suite time; assert contents and that each header label starts at the same column as its values.
demonstrations.observes: Section shows lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, over flag, suite run time; header offsets match.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing section or column fails contains asserts; misaligned header fails the offset assert.

demonstrations.method: Run the three gates in order and cite them as run in the evidence.
demonstrations.observes: fmt exits 0; then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` exits 0 with no warnings; then `cargo test --locked` exits 0 with every test above passing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code fails fmt; any clippy warning (e.g. unused code in code_health) fails clippy under -D warnings; any missing or broken behavior in criteria 1-7 fails cargo test.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff of CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG Unreleased has a code-health entry; decisions.md records the three thresholds, syn-vs-hand-rolled call, and the 10-landing cadence.
